parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of inconsistent rendering of the 'Other parameters' section but introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the 'Parameters' section as well.

issues.description: The change affects the 'Parameters' section in addition to the 'Other parameters' section, which is not directly related to the issue and introduces scope creep.
